description: Answers 'when will I be paid / what did I receive': period totals of settled vs upcoming payout money, the pending or deferred cycles with their expected amounts, and the last payout per channel. All marketplaces with a settlement feed; default window is the last 90 days.

channel.description: Limit to one channel. Default: all connected channels.

since.description: Start date (ISO, e.g. 2026-10-01, IST day). Default: 90 days ago.

until.description: End date (ISO, inclusive IST day). Default: today.

name: get_settlement_cycles
title: Get settlement cycles
